L2 Charging for Any Site

Reliable Level 2 charging wherever it fits: multifamily communities, workplaces, hotels, retail centers, municipal lots, and fleet depots. Every site runs on the EnviroSpark network and is supported by our team for the life of your chargers.

  • Access and pricing controls for residents, employees, guests, or the public
  • Host reporting, real-time monitoring, and remote diagnostics on our own network
  • Proactive maintenance by the EnviroSpark team
  • Direct support for site owners, property teams, and drivers

Post-installation support and service

We don't install and walk away.

Many charging companies disappear once the chargers are in the ground. EnviroSpark stays. The same EnviroSpark team that builds your stations maintains, monitors, and supports them for years to come.

Talk to Our Service Team

Proactive monitoring

Real-time network monitoring and remote diagnostics catch issues early, often before drivers notice.

Managed field service

We coordinate all service and installation between our in-house team and trusted local partners, so every repair is dispatched, tracked, and held to EnviroSpark standards.

Direct support

Fast, direct responses from people who know your site, not a ticket queue.

Resident and driver support

Residents and drivers get help when they need it, 24/7/365

Comprehensive reporting

Every site host gets real-time reporting on usage, uptime, and revenue through our network platform.

Long-term maintenance

Maintenance planned for years into the future, so your amenity keeps working for your drivers.

Our network and software

We're the operator, not just the installer.

EnviroSpark is a Charge Point Operator (CPO). We own and operate our own charging network, running on a comprehensive, industry-leading software stack. Site hosts get one accountable partner and full visibility into how every charger performs.
